description: List the comments on a file or folder (the Comments tab in Files), newest first, with their ID, author, time and whether they are unread. Pass path or fileId.

fileId.description: File ID, instead of path (from get_file_info)

limit.description: How many comments to return, at most 100 (default 50)

offset.description: Skip this many of the newest comments

name: list_file_comments
title: List File Comments
